name: Enhance Recycled Court Polo
description: An athletic-fit performance polo made from 100% recycled polyester with a moisture-wicking finish built for long matches in the heat. A mesh underarm panel adds extra airflow during aggressive point play, and the fabric resists wrinkling in a gear bag between games.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold with like colors and tumble dry low. Avoid fabric softener, which can reduce the moisture-wicking finish over repeated washes.
